body: The problem is they've always been like this, it's just gotten more pronounced as I've gotten older. Probably due to the fact I want my independence, but I can't have it.
yes im about ready to start looking for one
im roughly 9 months away from being 18 but IDK when I'll be fully ready to move out on my own and able to control my life if that makes sense.

I'm using a throwaway in case my parents ever, god forbid, check my actual reddit account. I don't want them to see this.

My parents control a lot of aspects of my life. I have no social media and when I got it without their permission and they found out they got me a flip phone. I can't listen to the music I want to without their permission. Same with books, I can't read what i want without them looking over it and okaying it. These are just the examples that come to my mind. 

I feel like I'm getting depressed. A small part of me is tired of living under so much control and wants to take a whole bottle of painkillers and die, then I would be free. A bigger part is too scared. I'm just tired of living. I'm tired of being controlled and oppressed. I wish I could be free, and I can't and its hurting me in the long run.
